task: Google Cloud: turn on Places API (New) and save a restricted key to the vault

steps.do: open the project picker, select kit-assistant-514520

steps.human: Link a billing account and add a card. Press Done when the page shows "Billing account linked".

steps.do: Billing > Budgets & alerts: $5, email alerts at 50/90/100%
APIs & Services > Library: enable Places API (New)
Credentials: create API key, restrict to Places API (New)

accept: GET Place Details for a known place id (https://places.googleapis.com/v1/places/ChIJj61dQgK6j4AR4GeTYWZsKWw with headers X-Goog-Api-Key: <vault key> and X-Goog-FieldMask: id,displayName) returns 200 from Kit's server. Use a GET: the guardrail hook on the Mac blocks POST to places.googleapis.com, so searchText is out.
notes: When restricting the key by IP address, add both the server's IPv4 and its IPv6 /64. Kit's box reached Google over IPv6, so an IPv4-only restriction returned 403.
